PRINCE WILLIAM COUNTY 
Development Services 
Building Development Division 
Commercial Policies and Procedures 
 
Address Validation Requirements 
 
Issued by: Eric M Mays, P.E. 
Building Official 
 
Effective: February 4, 2013 
Revised: April 26, 2021 
 
The correct addressing of buildings and tenant spaces is critical to public safety and is important to tracking historical information related to the occupancy of buildings. This policy provides the address validation/assignment requirements for commercial projects, including new structures and existing buildings (i.e., tenant layout and alteration/repair plans). 
 
New Structures 
The Address Validation/Assignment Plan Submittal for new structures shall include the following within the plan set: 
Architectural Site Plan showing the site location, building entrances and sprinkler control room exterior doors. 
Architectural Floor Plans showing the building entrances and suite entrances 
 
The Building Development Division will route the Address Validation/Assignment Plan Submittal to the Geospatial Technology Services Division (GTS) for review and/or assignment and approval. The GTS Address Validation/Assignment Plan Review comments will be incorporated into the plan review comment letter issued by the Building Development Division at the conclusion of each plan review cycle. 
 
Once the Address Validation/Assignment Plan Review has been approved, the approved addresses must be incorporated into the Building Code Plan Review Submission prior to being approved by the Building Development Division. Additionally, if a revision to the building design affects the previously approved addresses, a new Address Validation/Assignment Plan Submittal will be required. 
 
Existing Buildings (Tenant Layout and Alteration/Repair Plans) 
All Building Permit Applications and building plans submitted for existing commercial buildings shall have an Address Validation/Assignment Approval issued by GTS prior to acceptance by the Building Development Division.
